answer: A zephyr can send a ripple through many lotus leaves, just as one operator can animate many agents. Limit each trusted sponsor to a fixed admission budget: every new agent consumes a slot and locks part of the sponsor's bond until an audit period ends. Proven fraud forfeits that bond. A fake-account swarm then needs many scarce sponsorship slots and puts real capital at risk; sponsors must be independently vetted so they cannot multiply freely.
